changelog: Added progressive cold exposure timer (default 30 minutes continuous exposure before stamina drain).
Shelter and heat source detection: warming up in vehicles, interiors, under roofs, or near campfires and heaters.
Discreet cold warning notification and floating toast banner when felt temperature drops below 2°C.
Subtle cold frost blue screen vignette effect with adaptive opacity and zero CEF performance overhead.
100% in-game and config toggles for visual effects, warnings, stamina drain, optional cold damage, and exposure duration.
Exposed client exports GetColdExposurePercent, IsPlayerFreezing, and GetThermodynamicsSettings.
